sections.text:
This procedure details the items, which are checked every 5
years Y5. They include testing and major maintenance P2. In addition to the
procedures listed, it is expected the checks, which are done more frequently,
would also be completed at this time.

items:
A work permit 
must be issued and the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable 
safety category.

Safety fence 
with caution marks surrounding the work area.

Wear standard personal safety and healthy equipment as helmet, safety shoes, 
rubber gloves, ... etc.

Before doing maintenance, inspection, or service work on the unit be sure
 that the starting switch is in OFF position or the wiring disconnected from
 the line to prevent the unit from accidentally starting.

Do not throw the sump oil to the sewage because this oil will prevent the
 sewage treatment process. Collect it in tight containers and return it back
 to the vendor to recycle it. Always remember that "This oil is load for
 your wastes but it's valuable material for them. "Avoid oil spillage to
 the ground because this oil spillage has very bad impact on the environment.

Using solvents such as gasoline and others for cleaning the 1st, 2nd, 3 rd
 and 4th stage of Air Head and Valve, Cylinder and Piston is dangerous, it
 will expose lungs to very hazardous and carcinogenic chemicals. You have to
 wear your breathing mask.
Don't burn the cloth used in cleaning, collect it and send it to the dump.

Fix any oil leaks to prevent pollution and save money of wasted oil. Oil
 leaks to the ground have very bad impact on the environment, mainly on soil
 and ground water and eventually on the ecosystem. "It takes only 1
 liter of Hydrocarbon spilled in an aquifer to render 
 1,000,000 liters of
 potable water useless for human consumption.
Tool set, Cloth,
Sodium Hydroxide Solution, Benzene,
New air filter cartridge,
Grinding Past, gasket set,
O-ring set, Oil seal set.
Open the oil drain plug to drain the oil out of the sump (figure 2).
Disassemble inlet air filter figure 1.
Disassemble inlet manifold figures 1, 2 one bolt.
Disassemble 1 st stage discharge manifold figure 2.
Disassemble 2-nd stage inlet manifold.
Disassemble 2-nd stage discharge manifold.
Disassemble 3-rd stage discharge manifold.

items:

Repeat all the steps from 1 to 4 to make maintenance to the other unit of
 the first stage cylinder and piston.

Disconnect the two enplugs no.11, cross head No.12 cross head no.10.

Clean all parts with benzene and change O -ring no. 2, gasket no. 6,

Disassemble the inlet and outlet tubes between the stages and radiators

Pull out the fan and hub assembly no.3.

Pull out the cover fan end no.4.
Pull out the oil seal no.5

Pull out the complete oil pump from no.8 to no.16 (fig.17).
Remove the retaining ring no.19 and the washerno.20.
Remove the oil seal no.21and no.28.

Unscrew the two Allen screws from the coupling sleeve (that connect the
 two parts of coupling) and disconnect the two retaining ring then move the

Unscrew the two cap screws (no.62 fig.18) and four cap screws (58 fig.18)
 connecting the motor to compressor.

Disconnect the lock-nut no65 fig18 (use span tube55) then pull out the

Pull the crankshaft no. 24 figure 11with all parts.

Clean all parts with benzene and change ball bearing no. 15, 16 in case of
 motor driving and ball bearing no. 17 in case of belt driving.

Clean all parts of the oil pump figure 17, Change oil seal no.5, the fan
 gasket end cover no. 8, O-rings no.10, 15 oil seals no. 21, 28, gasket no.
 30 or change the oil pump complete if needed.

Reassemble the crankshaft with its cover, connecting rod master no. 6 with
 its bearings no. 11fig 11.

Reassemble all cylinders and pistons for all stages in there previous
 positions.

Reassemble all the entire valve to the airhead for all stages in their
 original position on their cylinders.
Unscrew the nut of its cover.

Clean the filter element no. 3 with flow of air and benzene and dry it
 with flow of air or replace it if needed.

Clean the oil bowl no. 4 with benzene and refill with new oil to its
 correct level.
Reassemble the inlet air filter in its place.

Disassemble the oil filter set (figure 14) and clean its parts and change
 oil filter element no. 5 figure 14.

Unscrew the separator for the four stages no. 1, 7, 13, 15, 18, clean with
 benzene, and dry with flow of air or replace if needed.
Clean and inspect for damaged fins of radiator.

By using close circuit with pump, clean the radiators tubes with flow of
 Sodium hydroxide solution, then water and dry it with flow of air.

Reassemble the separator to radiators block and reassemble the radiators
 block to its sub base.
Reassemble all manifolds (inlet, outlet) for all stages.

Refill the oil again in oil sump to a proper level between Max. and Min.
 marks of the lube oil dipstick and refill the oil pump and its tubes with
 oil. .
Refill motor ball bearing with grease
Run the compressor manually and listen to any abnormal sound.
Run the motor manually and listen to any abnormal sound.

Reassemble the motor no. (57 fig.18) to compressor with the screws no.62,
 58 fig.18.
Connect the coupling between the motor and the compressor 64 fig. 18.
Put the manual condensed drain valve on NO LOAD position 14 fig. 18.

Put the starting switch in ON position and operate the compressor
 and listening to any abnormal sound and observe the oil pressure gauge to be
 sure that the oil pump is operate in good condition
Put the manual condensed drain valve on FULL LOAD position.

Check every stage air pressure on pressure gauges (figure 9) First Stage 2
 atm.
Check oil pressure (2:4 atm) on oil pressure gauge.
Check for any air and oil leakage

Record the maintenance, which has-been done and all parts, which have been
 changed in maintenance cared.

Before putting the unite in service you have to do all following
 electrical test:
Switch off the main supply of 0.4 kV.
Switch off the control switches in cabinet.
Check oil pressure device termination.
Check the terminals of cables 0.4 kV at the two sides.

Check and cleaning the contacts of auxiliary relays in the control
 cabinets of the compressor.

Check and cleaning the contacts of air pressure and oil pressure
 manometers.
Check and cleaning the contacts of starting contactors.
Check the signal relays.
Check the starting time relay.
Check the control circuit
Check the electrical condensed valves and test them.

Check the air pressure stages as follows. First stage 2 atm
 Second stage 11 atm
 Third stage 40 atm

Oil pressure 2 - 4 atm and oil temperature 80 
 C.

Adjust the delay time between starting and loading the compressor stages
 about 30 sec.
Test the operating of compressors manually and automatically.
Put the compressor in service.
Record the measuring results on protection card.

Inlet Air Filter (Figure 13)
Unscrew the nut of its cover.
Clean the filter element no. 3 with flow of air and benzene and dry it
